applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning) Third Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: NBFCs must not recognize unrealized interest as income upon acquiring specified non-financial assets, reverse any such prior income by September 30, 2027, and properly account for SNFA income and expenses.
answer.action_quote: Where such income has been recognised in respect of any SNFA outstanding in the books of a NBFC as on September 30, 2026, it shall be reversed through Profit and Loss account, latest by September 30, 2027

effective_date.quote: The above amendment would come into force with effect from October 01, 2026.

comply_by.quote: reversed through Profit and Loss account, latest by September 30, 2027, to the extent remaining unrealised as on that date.
comply_by.what: Reverse previously recognized unrealized interest income from acquired specified non-financial assets through the Profit and Loss account to the extent remaining unrealized.

answer.amends: Master Directions - Non-Banking Financial Company - Systemically Important Non-Deposit taking Company and Deposit taking Company (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2016
